One box, one module; module names omit the prefix openTEPES_, and … stands for the prefix of the layer.
Green = implemented, white = planned (names indicative). A new sector adds modules in Layers 4 and 6 and an entry in openTEPES_InputSchema.py. ★ marks what the sweep modes need.
